scripts.keyboard: async(page)=>{const before={url:page.url(),aria:await page.locator("main").ariaSnapshot()};await page.getByRole("button",{name:"Services (2)",exact:true}).focus();await page.keyboard.press("Space");await page.waitForTimeout(700);const buttons=await page.getByRole("button",{name:/^(All|Services|Databases|Key Values|Env Groups) \(/}).evaluateAll(xs=>xs.map(x=>({text:x.textContent,pressed:x.getAttribute("aria-pressed"),selected:x.getAttribute("aria-selected"),role:x.getAttribute("role"),className:x.className})));const after={url:page.url(),aria:await page.locator("main").ariaSnapshot(),buttons,docWidth:await page.evaluate(()=>document.documentElement.scrollWidth)};await page.getByRole("heading",{name:"Unassigned",exact:true}).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await page.screenshot({path:"qa-a834-project-filter-mobile.png"});return{at:new Date().toISOString(),before,after};}
scripts.semanticDiagnostic: async(page)=>{await page.getByRole("heading",{name:"Unassigned",exact:true}).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await page.screenshot({path:"qa-a834-project-filter-desktop.png"});const before=await page.locator("main").ariaSnapshot();const previous=await page.getByRole("button",{name:/^(All|Services|Databases|Key Values|Env Groups) \(/}).evaluateAll(xs=>{const parent=xs[0].parentElement,prior={parentRole:parent.getAttribute("role"),buttons:xs.map(x=>x.getAttribute("aria-pressed"))};parent.setAttribute("role","group");const kinds=["all","services","databases","keyvalues","envgroups"],kind=new URL(location.href).searchParams.get("kind")||"all";xs.forEach((x,i)=>x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(kinds[i]===kind)));return prior;});try{return{at:new Date().toISOString(),before,diagnostic:await page.locator("main").ariaSnapshot(),temporaryBrowserAttributes:true};}finally{await page.getByRole("button",{name:/^(All|Services|Databases|Key Values|Env Groups) \(/}).evaluateAll((xs,prior)=>{const p=xs[0].parentElement;if(prior.parentRole===null)p.removeAttribute("role");else p.setAttribute("role",prior.parentRole);xs.forEach((x,i)=>{if(prior.buttons[i]===null)x.removeAttribute("aria-pressed");else x.setAttribute("aria-pressed",prior.buttons[i]);});},previous);}}
